newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes down in a dull session.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes down in a dull session.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed lower at 42.5440/5460 to the dollar in a dull session of interbank trading on Saturday, compared with the previous close of 42.5400/5430, dealers said.
"The market was dull. There were very few deals and most players were absent," said one dealer.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5440/5480 to the dollar in early trade.

The interbank call money rates dropped sharply following the maturity of central bank bills worth about 3.5 billion taka. Call money was traded at 3.5-5.0 percent, down from Thursday's 6.75-7.25 percent, dealers said.
